A simple fist-fighting practice game. Find suitable fist-fighting animations from the Roblox Creator Store, a training dummy asset, and VFX and SFX for attacks and impacts. Let me preview and select the Marketplace assets before building. Show a clear on-screen hit counter that increases by exactly one every time a punch hits the dummy, and never on a miss. Use a clean readable game UI. No weapons, kicks, PvP or AI opponents. Use sensible defaults for other details.
